subject: Kickoff: Evergreen vendor setup – PO requirements, timeline & line-item format
messages:
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@evergreen.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Evergreen Inc. Procurement <procurement@evergreen.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO process for Evergreen Inc.

Hi Jordan,

We're starting the vendor onboarding for Redwood so we can issue POs and route invoices to AP. Can you confirm:

- Which vendor forms and tax docs you need from us vs. what you expect us to send? (W-9, EFT, PO contact, remit address)
- The typical PO issuance timeline once we return completed onboarding docs
- Required fields you require on the PO and on invoices (PO number placement, SOW ref, GL codes, line-item expectations)
- Whether you support consolidated monthly invoicing or require one invoice per PO

Attached is our Evergreen vendor onboarding checklist — fillable fields welcome. Our internal PO approver is Mark Dawson (cc'd on this thread).

Thanks — looking to get this moving this week.

Best,
Lisa Moreno
Sr. Procurement Manager
Evergreen Inc.
procurement@evergreen.com

Attachment: Evergreen-Vendor-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@evergreen.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO process for Evergreen Inc.

Hi Lisa — thanks for the checklist and for looping Mark in. Quick answers and an attached starter packet: Vendor-Setup-Form.xlsx and our W9.pdf.

High level timeline (typical):
- Day 0: We receive completed vendor form + W-9 + remit details
- Day 0–1: Internal validation (tax ID + remit)
- Day 2 (business days): PO issued from Evergreen once vendor profile is active

If you require paper signatures or a customized contract add 1–3 business days. If you have a preferred DocuSign link we can sign electronically.

PO/invoice requirements (suggested minimal fields we expect):
- PO Number (must appear on invoice header)
- Invoice Date and Invoice Number
- Bill To (company name + AP email) and Remit To (address or EFT details)
- Line-item rows: Description, Redwood SKU / Service Code, Quantity, Unit Price, Currency, Line Total
- Service period (start — end) for subscription or SOW-based lines
- SOW or Contract reference (if applicable)
- Tax amount / taxable indicator
- Internal GL code (optional but very helpful for faster posting)

Suggested line-item example (CSV-friendly):
"item_description","service_code","qty","unit_price","currency","service_start","service_end","sow_ref","gl_code"
"Redwood Inference API - Dedicated Capacity (May)","RI-DED-1000",1,12000,USD,2026-05-01,2026-05-31,EVG-SOW-12,4000-00

Payment terms: Our standard is Net 30. If Evergreen requires Net 45 for new vendors, please flag and we'll note it internally.

A couple of quick clarifying questions for Evergreen to confirm:
1) Do you require our vendor legal name and remit address to match exactly as on W-9?
2) Do you need Redwood to include tax-exempt certificates or supplier diversity fields?
3) Do you accept consolidated monthly invoices covering multiple POs or prefer invoice-per-PO?

I've attached a simple PO sample (Redwood-PO-sample.csv) that mirrors the line-item format above.

Next steps: please return the completed Vendor-Setup-Form.xlsx and W9.pdf (if not already on file). Once we have those, we will confirm internal GL mapping and aim for PO issuance in 48 business hours.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO process for Evergreen Inc.

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list and the sample. A few notes from Evergreen AP and procurement:

- We require PO number on the invoice header and the PO number must match the invoice references for auto-posting.
- Remit: Evergreen Inc., Accounts Payable, ap@evergreen.com. EFT details are collected via our secure portal after vendor validation.
- Current payment terms for new vendors are Net 45; after 2 successful, timely invoices we can move to Net 30 (Finance approval).
- We prefer one invoice per PO for AP reconciliation, but we can accept consolidated monthly billing only if each line references the originating PO and we receive a summary CSV.
- GL codes: not required at invoice time but include if you can — speeds up posting.

Mark (cc): please confirm if Evergreen needs any additional tax forms besides the W-9 (e.g., state withholding forms).

We'll complete the vendor onboarding checklist and return the completed form today.

Best,
Lisa

Attachment: Evergreen-Vendor-Checklist-filled.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor setup & PO process for Evergreen Inc.

Hi Lisa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarifications. Per your answers, we will:

- Ensure PO number is prominent on the invoice header.
- Provide remit address and EFT instructions in the vendor form; expect AP to confirm via secure portal.
- Mark Net 45 as the initial payment term in our billing system and note a follow-up after two successful invoices.
- Provide GL codes on a best-effort basis in our invoices and include them in the summary CSV if you accept consolidated billing.

Confirming timeline: once we get the signed vendor form + filled checklist and your confirmation that Mark has validated the vendor profile, Evergreen should be able to issue the first PO within 2 business days.

As next steps I'm attaching the following to this thread for your AP team: Vendor-Setup-Form.xlsx (fillable), W9.pdf, Redwood-PO-sample.csv. If you prefer us to submit via DocuSign, we can do that as well.
